summary: testDisablingAnalyticsStopsReportingAndPersistsPreference only proves the disabled(false) preference survives a fresh AnalyticsService read; it never re-enables after disabling and re-instantiates to confirm the re-enabled(true) preference also persists, so an asymmetric bug (defaults.set only called on disable) would pass every current test while violating REQ-010.2.3's 'preserve a user's preference' for the true case.
